metrics.scope: RuleProfile synchronous wall/thread-CPU intervals: direct instrumented children discounted once; mean/max exclusive per rule. Added native model/exclusion/construct_instance/model_to_dict/text events, so exclusive times differ in scope from older profiles. Inline authority predicates still included in validate_submission, not separately measured or assumed invariant. Supplementary cProfile native call graph uses its own wall timer, includes recursion/call overhead and is not summed with RuleProfile. No locals, SQL, parameters or argument values recorded. Native per-call max/p95 not_measured; this call graph is supplemental, not the per-rule report.
metrics.overhead: One sequential control then combined RuleProfile+cProfile sample, control response/context retained. Difference includes wrappers, native call tracer, host/PG/OS cache/retained objects; causal overhead not_measured, no correction applied. cProfile-inclusive/exclusive uses native call graph, not the selected-wrapper child graph. Results cannot be used as operational latency or compared as equal-instrumentation timing to earlier narrower profiles.
metrics.not_measured: rows_returned/affected/scanned; DB CPU/waits/locks/IO; RSS/allocations; standalone inline authority predicate time; per-rule p95; causal profiler overhead; concurrent capacity
